# pkc/fetch

> pkc: downloading packages from the registry (port of internal/registry).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/fetch.pkg)

`fe_url(base, name)` builds a package's URL like the Go compiler, with
path segments escaped like Go's `url.PathEscape`. `fe_fetch` reads a
`file://` registry directly and downloads `http(s)://` packages with
`curl`. `fe_fetch_batch` fetches a whole round at once: one
`curl --parallel` for every `http(s)://` package, like the Go compiler's
parallel downloads. If that fails, each package is fetched again on its
own, so errors carry the same messages as the Go compiler.

Routes send the packages under a name prefix to their own registry
(`fe_routes`, `fe_base_for`); `fe_read_tree` reads them from the
`pkg_tree.pkg` next to a program (port of internal/registry/tree.go).

```
fn fe_name_char(c: u8, first: bool) -> bool
  if c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c == '_'
    return true
  end
  if c >= '0' && c <= '9'
    return !first
  end
  return c == '-' || c == '\'' || c == '?' || c == '!' || c == '+' || c == '*' || c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '=' || c == '&' || c == '|' || c == '~' || c == '^'
end

// fe_valid_name: segments of name characters separated by '/'; a segment
// doesn't start with a digit.
fn fe_valid_name(name: str) -> bool
  let first = true
  for i = 0 to len(name) - 1
    let c = name[i]
    if c == '/'
      if first
        return false
      end
      first = true
    elif !fe_name_char(c, first)
      return false
    else
      first = false
    end
  end
  return !first
end

// fe_escape escapes one path segment like Go's url.PathEscape.
fn fe_escape(seg: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  for i = 0 to len(seg) - 1
    let c = seg[i]
    let keep = c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9'
    keep = keep || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.' || c == '~' || c == '$' || c == '&' || c == '+' || c == '=' || c == ':' || c == '@'
    if keep
      sb_byte(b, c)
    else
      sb_byte(b, '%')
      let digits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
      sb_byte(b, digits[((c as int) >> 4) & 15])
      sb_byte(b, digits[(c as int) & 15])
    end
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn fe_unescape(s: str) -> str
  let b = sb_new()
  let i = 0
  while i < len(s)
    if s[i] == '%' && i + 2 < len(s)
      let ok = true
      let v = fe_hexval(s[i + 1]) * 16 + fe_hexval(s[i + 2])
      if fe_hexval(s[i + 1]) >= 0 && fe_hexval(s[i + 2]) >= 0
        sb_byte(b, v as u8)
        i = i + 3
        continue
      end
    end
    sb_byte(b, s[i])
    i = i + 1
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end

fn fe_hexval(c: u8) -> int
  if c >= '0' && c <= '9'
    return (c as int) - 48
  elif c >= 'a' && c <= 'f'
    return (c as int) - 87
  elif c >= 'A' && c <= 'F'
    return (c as int) - 55
  end
  return -1
end

fn fe_url(base: str, name: str) -> str
  let segs = str_split(name, '/')
  let esc = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(segs) - 1
    vec_push_str(esc, fe_escape(vec_get_str(segs, i)))
  end
  return str_concat4(str_rtrim(base, '/'), "/", str_join(esc, "/"), ".pkg")
end

// the routes in use: name prefixes and their registries (strs), or null
global fe_route_prefixes: ptr Vec
global fe_route_bases: ptr Vec

fn fe_routes(prefixes: ptr Vec, bases: ptr Vec)
  fe_route_prefixes = prefixes
  fe_route_bases = bases
end

// fe_base_for returns the registry that hosts package name: the route
// with the longest matching prefix, else base.
fn fe_base_for(base: str, name: str) -> str
  if fe_route_prefixes == null
    return base
  end
  let best = -1
  for i = 0 to vec_len(fe_route_prefixes) - 1
    let p = vec_get_str(fe_route_prefixes, i)
    if (name == p || str_starts(name, str_concat(p, "/"))) && len(p) > best
      base = vec_get_str(fe_route_bases, i)
      best = len(p)
    end
  end
  return base
end

// fe_pkg_url is where package name is hosted, with the routes applied.
fn fe_pkg_url(base: str, name: str) -> str
  return fe_url(fe_base_for(base, name), name)
end

// the package tree read by fe_read_tree
global fe_tree_default: str
global fe_tree_prefixes: ptr Vec
global fe_tree_bases: ptr Vec

// fe_tree_path is where the tree of source file src lives: pkg_tree.pkg
// in the same folder.
fn fe_tree_path(src: str) -> str
  let i = len(src)
  while i > 0 && src[i - 1] != '/'
    i = i - 1
  end
  return str_concat(str_slice(src, 0, i), "pkg_tree.pkg")
end

// fe_read_tree reads the package tree of source file src:
//
//   tree
//     acme  http://localhost:8080
//     *     https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DominicThemiya/Packenger/main/registry
fn fe_read_tree(src: str) -> bool
  let path = fe_tree_path(src)
  if !io_exists(path)
    return u_fail(str_concat4(src, " uses pkg_tree, but there is no ", path, ""))
  end
  let ok = false
  let text = io_read_file(path, &ok)
  if !ok
    return u_fail(str_concat3("read ", path, ": can't read the file"))
  end
  fe_tree_default = ""
  fe_tree_prefixes = vec_new()
  fe_tree_bases = vec_new()
  let in_tree = false
  let lines = str_split(text, '\n')
  for i = 0 to vec_len(lines) - 1
    let line = vec_get_str(lines, i)
    let at = str_concat4(path, ":", str_from_int(i + 1), ": ")
    let t = str_trim(line)
    if t == "" || str_starts(t, "//")
      continue
    end
    if line[0] != ' ' && line[0] != '\t'
      if t != "tree" || in_tree
        return u_fail(str_concat(at, "expected one 'tree' section"))
      end
      in_tree = true
      continue
    end
    if !in_tree
      return u_fail(str_concat(at, "expected one 'tree' section"))
    end
    let f = str_fields(t)
    if vec_len(f) != 2
      return u_fail(str_concat(at, "expected '<prefix> <registry url>'"))
    end
    let prefix = vec_get_str(f, 0)
    let base = str_rtrim(vec_get_str(f, 1), '/')
    if prefix != "*" && !fe_valid_name(prefix)
      return u_fail(str_concat3(at, str_quote(prefix), " is not a package name or *"))
    end
    if !str_starts(base, "http://") && !str_starts(base, "https://") && !str_starts(base, "file://")
      return u_fail(str_concat(at, "the registry must be an http://, https:// or file:// URL"))
    end
    if vec_has_str(fe_tree_prefixes, prefix) || prefix == "*" && fe_tree_default != ""
      return u_fail(str_concat3(at, prefix, " has two routes"))
    end
    if prefix == "*"
      fe_tree_default = base
    else
      vec_push_str(fe_tree_prefixes, prefix)
      vec_push_str(fe_tree_bases, base)
    end
  end
  if !in_tree
    return u_fail(str_concat(path, ": no 'tree' section"))
  end
  return true
end

// fe_fetch returns the source of package name; *origin is its URL. On an
// error it sets pk_err and *ok to false.
fn fe_fetch(base: str, name: str, origin: ptr str, ok: ptr bool) -> str
  *ok = false
  if !fe_valid_name(name)
    u_fail(str_concat("invalid package name ", str_quote(name)))
    return ""
  end
  let u = fe_pkg_url(base, name)
  *origin = u
  if str_starts(u, "file://")
    let path = fe_unescape(str_slice(u, 7, len(u)))
    if !io_exists(path)
      u_fail(str_concat4("package ", str_quote(name), " not found in registry (", str_concat(u, ")")))
      return ""
    end
    let read = false
    let src = io_read_file(path, &read)
    if !read
      u_fail(str_concat4("can't read package ", str_quote(name), " (", str_concat(u, ")")))
      return ""
    end
    *ok = true
    return src
  end
  return fe_curl(name, u, ok)
end

global fe_tmp_count: int = 0

fn fe_tmp() -> str
  fe_tmp_count = fe_tmp_count + 1
  return str_concat4("/tmp/pkc-", str_from_int(syscall(39)), "-", str_from_int(fe_tmp_count))
end

fn fe_curl_args() -> ptr Vec
  let args = vec_new()
  vec_push_str(args, "--silent")
  vec_push_str(args, "--fail")
  vec_push_str(args, "--location")
  vec_push_str(args, "--user-agent")
  vec_push_str(args, "packenger")
  vec_push_str(args, "--max-time")
  vec_push_str(args, "30")
  return args
end

// fe_fetch_batch fetches every package in names. For each, it pushes the
// source to srcs, the URL to origins and the error ("" if none) to errs.
fn fe_fetch_batch(base: str, names: ptr Vec, srcs: ptr Vec, origins: ptr Vec, errs: ptr Vec)
  // which packages are downloaded over http(s), and where to
  let remote = vec_new()
  let tmps = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(names) - 1
    let name = vec_get_str(names, i)
    let tmp = ""
    if fe_valid_name(name) && !str_starts(fe_pkg_url(base, name), "file://")
      tmp = fe_tmp()
      vec_push(remote, i)
    end
    vec_push_str(tmps, tmp)
  end
  let fast = false
  if vec_len(remote) > 1
    let args = fe_curl_args()
    vec_push_str(args, "--parallel")
    vec_push_str(args, "--parallel-max")
    vec_push_str(args, "16")
    for k = 0 to vec_len(remote) - 1
      let i = vec_get(remote, k)
      vec_push_str(args, "--output")
      vec_push_str(args, vec_get_str(tmps, i))
      vec_push_str(args, fe_pkg_url(base, vec_get_str(names, i)))
    end
    fast = os_run("curl", args) == 0
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(names) - 1
    let name = vec_get_str(names, i)
    let tmp = vec_get_str(tmps, i)
    let src = ""
    let origin = ""
    let ok = false
    if fast && tmp != ""
      origin = fe_pkg_url(base, name)
      src = io_read_file(tmp, &ok)
      if !ok
        u_fail(str_concat3("can't download package ", str_quote(name), ": the download disappeared"))
      end
    else
      src = fe_fetch(base, name, &origin, &ok)
    end
    if tmp != ""
      syscall(87, cstr(tmp))
    end
    vec_push_str(srcs, src)
    vec_push_str(origins, origin)
    if ok
      vec_push_str(errs, "")
    else
      vec_push_str(errs, pk_err)
    end
  end
end

// fe_curl downloads one URL with curl into a temporary file.
fn fe_curl(name: str, u: str, ok: ptr bool) -> str
  let tmp = fe_tmp()
  let args = fe_curl_args()
  vec_push_str(args, "--output")
  vec_push_str(args, tmp)
  vec_push_str(args, u)
  let status = os_run("curl", args)
  let read = false
  let src = ""
  if status == 0
    src = io_read_file(tmp, &read)
  end
  syscall(87, cstr(tmp))
  if read
    *ok = true
    return src
  end
  if status == -1
    u_fail(str_concat3("can't download package ", str_quote(name), ": curl is not installed"))
  elif status == 6
    u_fail(str_concat4("can't download package ", str_quote(name), ": cannot resolve ", str_concat(fe_host(u), " (offline, or a DNS problem)")))
  elif status == 22
    u_fail(str_concat4("package ", str_quote(name), " not found in registry (", str_concat(u, ")")))
  else
    u_fail(str_concat4("can't download package ", str_quote(name), ": curl failed with status ", str_from_int(status)))
  end
  return ""
end

fn fe_host(u: str) -> str
  let start = str_find(u, "://", 0)
  if start < 0
    return u
  end
  start = start + 3
  let stop = str_find_byte(u, '/', start)
  if stop < 0
    stop = len(u)
  end
  return str_slice(u, start, stop)
end
```
